versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Academic Deep Research skill for rigorous, reproducible investigations.
- Mandates two research cycles per theme, with APA 7th style citations and explicit evidence hierarchy.
- Requires user checkpoints at clarification and research planning phases for transparency and customizability.
- Executes multi-tool research using only native SkillBoss platform tools (web_search, web_fetch, sessions_spawn).
- Designed for academic literature reviews, competitive intelligence, or any exhaustive, methodical research need.
